entries.what: A user name and password sign-in to Tableau Cloud. MFA has been required there since 2022-02-01 (help.tableau.com/current/online/en-us/security_auth.htm), and with MFA on Tableau authentication a REST sign-in needs a PAT. The same call still works against an on-premise Tableau Server, so this depends on the target.

source.quote: You must use a PAT, instead of user name and password, to make a REST API sign in request to Tableau Cloud.

lookFor: TableauAuth( from tableauserverclient, when the server is a Tableau Cloud site
entries.replacement: A personal access token (PAT), or a unified access token.
requires: Someone has to create the token and store it as a secret: it replaces the password in the environment.
